title: Choir and Visitor
author: Mara Vasquez
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
